rows.basis: The MD&A attributes AEC growth to 'ramping of our AEC solutions at our first hyperscale data center customer'; Credo reports one segment and states no AI or data-center revenue amount or share, so nothing is quantified (total revenue 184.2M).
The release says fiscal 2024 success was 'primarily driven by our customers' AI deployments'; no AI amount, share or data-center line is stated (total revenue 193.0M).
Releases call customers' AI infrastructure deployments 'the catalyst' for growth and cite hyperscaler demand 'to power advanced AI services'; no AI amount or share is stated (total revenue 436.8M).

The MD&A says AEC ramps at hyperscale data center customers 'contributed over 99% of the increase in revenue' (436.8M to 1,335.1M); that is growth attribution, not a stated AI share of revenue, and per the thesis whole_business is not used.
The FY2023 release expects 'this shift' to accelerate demand for high-speed, energy-efficient connectivity; it states no AI amount and does not name AI explicitly in the quote.
The FY2024 release anticipates 'accelerating demand for AI infrastructure'; no amount stated.
Releases describe AI infrastructure deployments as the catalyst for 'expected growth' and a hyperscaler AI demand trend expected to persist; no amount stated.
